definition.text: One part type or part instance: its identity, its classification in published systems, its property values with their basis, and the files it is made from (Open Material).

description.text: One part type or part instance: its identity, its classification in published systems, its property values with their basis, and the files it is made from (Open Material).

definition.text: The part's ISA-95 material definition identifier, as a URI.
The IEC 61406 identification link (a GS1 Digital Link under EN 18219 is accepted).
The AAS globalAssetId the identification link resolves to.
How the part is identified: its IEC 61406 identification link and the AAS globalAssetId it resolves to.
The classification system, such as etim, ifc or cci.
The part's classes in published systems: ETIM for the product, IFC and CCI for the element.
The property's data type as its dictionary publishes it.
The units the property's dictionary allows, as the dictionary publishes their symbols.
Values of the classification's properties, each keyed by its published property URI.
Values of the IFC Pset_ManufacturerTypeInformation properties.
True when the part is counted in bulk and carries no quantity.
How the part is supplied and counted in an assembly.
The ISA-95 job order material requirement the part answers.
The file format beyond its media type, such as iso-10303-242 or dstv-nc-8.0.
The part's geometry and machining files (AP242, AP238, DSTV NC/XNC), referenced by URI and SHA-256, never embedded.
Each dimension the form kind needs, mapped to the published property that holds its value.

The part's parametric base form: a form kind whose dimensions are read, by property URI, from the part's own typeProperties or, for a dimension that varies by occurrence, from an assembly occurrence's parameters. Each value is held once. It is the design and coordination form a model is generated from; the part's fabrication geometry stays the AP242 file in fabricationFiles, which governs fabrication wherever both exist.
Who authored the record, when, from which sources, and whether it is illustrative.
